title: vitis scortechinii
intro: Vitis scortechinii, commonly known as the Chinese grapevine, is a species of grapevine native to China. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Vitis scortechinii include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing oxidative stress and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Vitis scortechinii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenols that contribute to its medicinal properties.
